summary: Frontend-only mobile retest of checkpoint 0430c5c. The review request reached me truncated, so I worked out the scope from the git diff: WeeklyStrip now uses pointer events for the tap fix, and the AdminGoals/AdminTrips TabsList wrap, card min-w-0 and long-title break-words changes. Result: ALL TARGET FIXES PASS. (1) WeeklyStrip touch tap: tested in a context with has_touch and is_mobile at 390px, using locator.tap(). On /admin/workers, Mon/Thu/Sun each open the popover with the correct day text. Tapping the same tile again closes it. Tapping outside closes it. On /worker (lovetest), Mon/Sun/Wed open the popover, clamped inside the strip (Sun x=113..353). Desktop mouse still works: hover opens, click does not toggle it closed, mouse leave closes. (2) /admin/goals and /admin/trips at 320px: documentElement scrollWidth is 320 = clientWidth, so the sideways scroll is gone. The TabsList wraps to 2 rows (16..304, height 66) and the cards span 16..304. At 390px: scrollWidth 390, cards 16..374. (3) A long unbroken title (88 chars, no spaces) wraps inside the card at both 320 and 390, with title scrollWidth equal to clientWidth. (4) Emoji picker regression: the popover stays within the viewport (320: 12..308, 390: 16..378). Picking 🔥 adds the chip and tapping the chip removes it, with both POST /react calls returning 200.

ui_bugs.issue: Focusing a day tile and pressing Enter/Space no longer opens the popover. Keyboard-triggered clicks fire no pointerdown, so lastPointer.current keeps its default/last value 'mouse' and onClick ignores the click. Before this change, onClick always toggled. Fix: in onClick, check e.detail === 0 (keyboard) or reset lastPointer after each click; or add onFocus/onBlur handlers.

issues: The TODAY / WEEK / MONTH / YEAR mini-stat row (AdminGoals.jsx ~line 375-395) is cramped. The 'MONTH' and 'YEAR' labels touch and the $ values almost collide. Consider grid-cols-2 below the sm breakpoint, or smaller tracking on the labels.

action_items: Optional: restore keyboard activation for WeeklyStrip tiles (handle e.detail === 0 in onClick).
Optional: make the goal card's Today/Week/Month/Year stat row grid-cols-2 below 360px.
critical_code_review_comments: WeeklyStrip: the pointer-event approach is correct. Touch-generated compatibility mouseenter events no longer fire onPointerEnter with pointerType 'mouse', and the document pointerdown listener closes the popover on an outside tap. The only gap is keyboard access, which relies on the lastPointer ref.

AdminGoals and AdminTrips both contain near-identical goal card markup (the same class edits were made in both files). This is a DRY violation, so consider extracting a shared GoalCardAdmin component.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the targeted fixes (WeeklyStrip tap, 320px overflow, long-title wrap, emoji picker regression)

seed_data_creation: Created a TEST_ goal and a TEST_ trip with long titles as admin, then deleted both (DELETE returned 200). A 🔥 reaction was added and removed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use browser.new_context(viewport, has_touch=True, is_mobile=True) with locator.tap() for real tap behaviour. Login testids: login-email, login-password, login-submit. Overflow check: compare document.documentElement.scrollWidth with clientWidth. The mobile top nav (m-nav-*) is a horizontal scroller, so its elements extending past the viewport are expected.
rca of the issue: The previous WeeklyStrip tap failure (iteration 15) is resolved by using pointerType-guarded onPointerEnter/onPointerLeave. The 320px overflow is resolved by the TabsList flex-wrap/h-auto change and the card min-w-0 change.
